items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: Sweets said, 'Well, man, let's stay here. They want me to take a combo into the Casino...'

ctx.x: Yeah. And so when I got there for the second Benny Carter band, he was out of jail. So the hotel served a very short notice on Benny Carter and told him that they were going to pay him two weeks' money in order for Les Brown to come in, the main dining room. So Benny didn't give them any lip or anything. He packed up, bag and baggage, and told the band that that was their last night. And they gave him half of the money and told him to come back the next week and they'd give him the other half, you know, for the…

items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: Harry Sweets Edison drove his Cadillac to the union and Kolax Coleax is sitting in the co-pilot's seat and I'm in the back seat.

ctx.x: I know they had announced a fantastic lineup of stars they were going to have there.

Yeah. Well, the results now, after they closed up the place, all of these performers didn't have any money to eat on, so the hotel served free meals to the performers and the musicians, and we all had to be in the dining room on time. If you missed a meal you couldn't come back and say, 'I'm hungry.' It wasn't like that. You had to be there and sit down and eat, everyone at the same time. So we're trying to get some money to get out of town, you know, a part of our money that was due us. And we didn't know which…
So you never got your money.
